O Colégio Anglo-Americano, instituição de ensino de natureza privada, foi fundado em 1919, como British American School, pela educadora Maguerth Coney, com a finalidade principal de atender a filhos de diplomatas radicados na então capital federal.

Na década de 70, já sob a direção do Prof. Ney Suassuna, o Colégio passou por significativas transformações em sua orientação pedagógica e grande expansão no plano nacional e internacional.

Coerentes com a busca na construção do aprender a aprender, com responsabilidade e comprometimento pelo próprio aprendizado, consolidou sua marca nesses 104 anos de existência, uma imagem que integra tradição e modernidade, estando sempre na vanguarda da Educação formando empreendedores bilíngues.

O Anglo-Americano recebe alunos da Educação Infantil ao Ensino Médio e tem seu Projeto Pedagógico definido como cognitivista, com ênfase no sócio interacionismo. O Anglo informa, forma e transforma seus alunos, em processo constante de ação e reflexão, compromissado em prepará-los para as etapas seguintes do aprendizado e para atuação criativa e empreendedora na vida.

title: assistant marketing manager
description:
Company Description

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free-minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

THE HOTEL

Sofitel, a global reference in French luxury hospitality, announces the transformation of Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema into its first flagship hotel in Brazil, with an expected opening by the end of 2026.

Located on Ipanema Beach, the hotel will feature 172 rooms and embody the brand's contemporary vision of luxury, experience, and service excellence.

Join the team of talents who will bring this new icon of luxury hospitality in Brazil to life.

Job Description

THE POSITION

The Assistant Marketing Manager - Social Media, Brand & Content supports the hotel's digital presence and brand strategy, managing content and campaigns across social media, websites, OTAs, and CRM platforms. This role plays a key part in shaping the hotel's digital identity, creating engaging content, and supporting the launch of new or renovated properties. The position ensures consistent messaging, guest engagement, and alignment with revenue and brand objectives.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the digital and social media strategy for a new luxury hotel brand, shaping its presence from pre-opening through ongoing operations to express a refined, aspirational, and globally recognized brand identity;
  • Create, curate, and oversee compelling content across social media, digital platforms, and multimedia campaigns, highlighting the hotel's unique services, experiences, and lifestyle;
  • Develop and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across Rooms, F&B, MICE, Spa, and other offerings to drive engagement, brand awareness, and revenue growth;
  • Manage pre-opening initiatives, including website setup, social media launch, and digital campaigns, to generate interest and anticipation ahead of the brand's debut;
  • Monitor digital performance, analyze engagement metrics, and optimize content and campaigns to maximize visibility, interaction, and business results;
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, revenue, and operations teams to ensure integrated strategies, consistent brand messaging, and high-end guest experiences;
  • Maintain a strong brand voice and identity across all digital channels, ensuring storytelling aligns with the hotel's global positioning;
  • Monitor social media trends, digital innovations, and best practices in luxury hospitality marketing to enhance the brand's digital presence/
  • Prepare regular reports on digital performance, KPIs, and campaign results, providing actionable insights to inform strategy and decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or related field;
  • Proven experience in social media management, digital content creation and brand marketing, preferably in luxury hospitality;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. French is a plus;
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and project coordination skills;
  • Deep knowledge of current digital marketing concepts, trends, and innovations, with the ability to apply them strategically to elevate the brand's presence.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, social media management tools, and content creation platforms;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

title: Designer Grafico
description:
Detalhes: (Leia ate o final)

Buscamos um(a) Designer talentoso(a) e versátil para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este profissional será um pilar fundamental na intersecção entre Marketing, Produto e Branding, responsável por traduzir conceitos e estratégias em experiências visuais de alto impacto. O candidato ideal é um(a) criativo(a) multidisciplinar, com um portfólio robusto que demonstre excelência desde a criação de campanhas de marketing digital até o design de interfaces de usuário (UX/UI) para aplicativos e plataformas web.

Você irá colaborar com equipes de marketing, produto e desenvolvimento para garantir uma comunicação visual coesa e eficaz em todos os pontos de contato com o cliente, otimizando a performance de campanhas e a usabilidade de nossos produtos digitais.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

O detalhamento das responsabilidades é crucial para alinhar as expectativas. Abaixo, detalhamos as principais frentes de atuação para esta posição:

Design Gráfico e Criação de Campanhas


• Conceito e Criação: Desenvolver o conceito criativo e a identidade visual para campanhas de marketing 360º (online e offline), desde o brainstorming inicial até a execução final.


• Materiais de Marketing: Criar uma vasta gama de materiais para social media (posts, stories, banners), anúncios para mídia paga, e-mail marketing, landing pages e outros materiais de suporte a vendas.


• Branding: Garantir a consistência e a correta aplicação da marca em todos os materiais, atuando como um guardião da nossa identidade visual.

Marketing Digital e Performance


• Gestão de Tráfego e Analytics: Colaborar com a equipe de performance para criar anúncios otimizados para diferentes canais. Analisar métricas de engajamento e conversão (Analytics) para propor melhorias contínuas nos criativos.


• Meta Pixel e Rastreamento: Ter conhecimento prático na implementação e utilização do Meta Pixel para rastreamento de conversões e otimização de campanhas, trabalhando em conjunto com desenvolvedores quando necessário.


• Copywriting: Desenvolver textos e chamadas (CTAs) persuasivos para anúncios, posts e landing pages, com foco em conversão e alinhamento com o tom de voz da marca.

Design de Produto (UX/UI)


• UX para Aplicativos e WebApps: Projetar fluxos de usuário, wireframes, protótipos interativos e layouts de alta fidelidade para nossos aplicativos móveis e plataformas web, focando em usabilidade, acessibilidade e na melhor experiência para o usuário.


• UI Design: Criar interfaces intuitivas, esteticamente agradáveis e consistentes, desenvolvendo e mantendo nosso Design System.


• Pesquisa e Testes: Colaborar em pesquisas com usuários e testes de usabilidade para validar hipóteses de design e iterar sobre as soluções propostas.

Apresentações e Comunicação


• Apresentações de Alto Impacto: Criar apresentações corporativas, comerciais e de resultados que sejam visualmente impressionantes, claras e persuasivas, utilizando ferramentas como Google Slides, Keynote ou PowerPoint.

Qualificações e HabilidadesRequisitos Obrigatórios:


• Experiência Comprovada: Mínimo de 3-5 anos de experiência como Designer, com um portfólio que demonstre projetos relevantes nas áreas de design gráfico, web design, social media e UX/UI.


• Domínio de Ferramentas: Proficiência avançada no pacote Adobe Creative Cloud, especialmente Photoshop e InDesign. Experiência sólida com ferramentas de UX/UI como Figma, Sketch ou Adobe XD.


• Fundamentos de Design: Sólido conhecimento em teoria das cores, tipografia, composição e hierarquia visual.


• Design de Interface: Experiência comprovada em design de interfaces para web e mobile, com compreensão de princípios de usabilidade e design responsivo.


• Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.

Diferenciais (Qualificações Desejáveis):


• Analytics e Dados: Experiência com ferramentas de análise como Google Analytics, e capacidade de interpretar dados para informar decisões de design.


• Gestão de Tráfego: Conhecimento em plataformas de anúncios como Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) e Google Ads.


• Copywriting: Habilidades de escrita criativa e persuasiva para marketing.


• Meta Pixel: Experiência prática com a configuração e análise de dados do Meta Pixel.


• HTML/CSS: Noções básicas de HTML e CSS para melhor colaboração com a equipe de desenvolvimento.

title: Treinador Operacional

Somos uma das maiores rede de franquias do Brasil, a turma por trás de marcas incríveis como Spoleto, Koni, Gendai, China in Box, Le Bonton, Gurumê e 2V Deli & Conveniência.

Uma empresa que nasceu com o propósito de democratizar a boa culinária e que está crescendo em um ritmo muito acelerado. Quer saber um pouquinho mais sobre a nossa história? Aproveita e dá uma lida no resuminho que tem ali embaixo ;)

Se você curte um ambiente descontraído, ama inovação e aprender coisas novas, o Grupo Trigo é o seu lugar. Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência em cozinha e perfil didático, que será responsável por aplicar treinamentos operacionais nas unidades das marcas asiáticas do trigo, garantindo a padronização dos processos e o desenvolvimento das equipes. E aí, se identificou? Não hesite em se candidatar agora mesmo.

Vem com a gente e faça parte desse time onde cada dia é uma deliciosa descoberta

  • Ministrar treinamentos práticos e teóricos para novos colaboradores e reciclagens para equipes já atuantes;
  • Desenvolver líderes operacionais como multiplicadores internos;
  • Garantir a padronização de processos, receitas e técnicas conforme os manuais da empresa;
  • Realizar auditorias e aplicar checklists de qualidade e desempenho nas unidades;
  • Acompanhar a performance das equipes, propondo melhorias operacionais com base em indicadores;
  • Criar e atualizar materiais didáticos como manuais e vídeos de treinamento;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prévia com cozinha;
  • Didática e habilidade para ensinar e motivar equipes;
  • Conhecimento avançado em técnicas culinárias e gestão operacional;
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas operacionais e propor soluções rápidas;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pelo Brasil e flexibilidade de horários;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Pacote Office (especialmente Excel) e Canva.

Informações adicionais

Remuneração: Salário (R$3.170,33) + Vale Transporte / Ticket Car (Desc. R$ 1,00) + Vale Refeição / Vale Alimentação (R$32/dia) + GymPass + Plano de Saúde Amil + Plano Odontológico Amil + Auxílio Farmácia OMNI + Psicologia Viva + Convênio com Sesc + Convênio com faculdades + Convênio com cursos de idiomas + PLR + Trilha de Carreira

Um sonho que começou em 1992 com dois amigos e o propósito de democratizar a boa culinária. Mais de 30 anos se passaram e hoje somos a maior holding brasileira de comida de verdade com mais de seiscentos restaurantes espalhados pelo Brasil e detentora das marcas Spoleto, China in Box, Gendai, Koni, LeBonTon, Gurumê, 2V Deli & Conveniência, Pizzaria Spoleto e Asa Açaí.

Quando Eduardo Ourivio e Mário Chady embarcaram nesta jornada de aprendizado e crescimento, os valores Trigo já eram prioridade e assim a Família Trigo nasceu e, diariamente, se fortalece colocando em prática valores que vão muito além de palavras.

Valorizamos nossas pessoas e os Trigers, como são conhecidos os integrantes deste grande time, são uma potência em diversidade, alegria, inovação, gentileza e vontade de crescer

granulometria, limites de Atterberg, umidade (Speedy e fogareiro), compactação (Proctor), CBR/ISC, equivalente de areia, massa específica "in situ".

moldagem e rompimento de corpos de prova, slump test, teor de ar, compressão, tração na flexão, módulo de elasticidade.

title: BR-Specialist
description:
Summary
Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. We believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.nnAs a Specialist, you build brand loyalty, create owners of Apple products and services, and offer technical support. You're dedicated to selling products and troubleshooting, delivering an exceptional customer service experience that is unlike any other. A Specialist is curious — you ask questions to learn about our customers' needs so you can educate and empower them to get the most out of our products and customize purchase and service options to enrich their lives.

Description
Provide excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting product and service recommendations, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy.nnSupport customers having Apple product or software issues with care and empathy by troubleshooting, diagnosing, and addressing service concerns using all tools and resources provided by Apple.nnWork with team leaders to identify recurring repair problems and other service concerns, and make sure that feedback is provided to Apple.nnUnderstand and proactively stay up to date on Apple's products, services, purchase options, and sales and repair processes.nnSupport your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apple's products, services, and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities.nMaintain accuracy and follow guidance.nnPerform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.nnContribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other's differences and having the curiosity to learn.nnDemonstrate Apple's values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

title: Account Manager
description:
At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
We are looking for an Account Manager to come and join our team, you will work closely with internal functions (Finance, Project Management, Legal, Professional Services) to execute account retention and growth strategies for Zyte's strategic accounts.  

Customer satisfaction, business retention, and portfolio growth are the key drivers of success for this position. 

Requirements

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the lead point of contact for a defined portfolio of existing business accounts.
  • Cultivate meaningful and long-lasting client relationships.
  • Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximize profits.
  • Develop trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders and executive sponsors.
  • Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives.
  • Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement to meet sales quotas.
  • Forecast and track key account metrics (e.g. quarterly sales results and annual forecasts).
  • Prepare reports on account status.
  • Visiting clients and engaging with them on in person meetings
  • Assist with challenging client requests or issue escalations as needed.
  • Manage a set of Enterprise Accounts in the Americas market, individual account value between approximately $40k and $200k in annual revenues.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in an Account Management role.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently meet and/or exceed sales quotas in revenue retention and account expansion.
  • Energy, enthusiasm and the ability to work well under pressure in meeting deadlines and achieving goals.
  • Strong deal closing and negotiation skills in Large Enterprise and Mid-market accounts
  • High level of analytical and organisational skills, and excellent attention to detail.
  • Understanding of data harvesting / web crawling a plus - but not necessary.
  • Previous experience working in consultative selling within Professional Services and SaaS Products is a must.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Commercially savvy within a Tech Scaleup company, with a proven track-record of delivering/over-delivering against Sales quotas. 
  • Demonstrated experience using sales analytics and funnel management techniques to drive productivity, pipeline management, and accurate forecasting.
  • Proven track record of collaborating with Customer Success teams to grow and expand Enterprise accounts.
Benefits

By joining the Zyte team, you will:

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.
  • Have the freedom & flexibility to work remotely.
  • Get the chance to work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

title: Production Operator
description:
The Production Operator will be responsible for safely operating and monitoring the facility's process and utility systems to ensure stable and efficient offshore production. This includes operating separation, compression, dehydration, seawater injection and utility systems, preparing equipment for maintenance, performing process analyses, supporting emergency response actions, and ensuring compliance with operational and safety procedures. The role contributes to maintaining safe operations, equipment integrity, and consistent production performance.

Responsibilities

  • Start/stop and operate oil and produced gas separation plants, gas compressors, glycol dehydration, HPU systems, produced water systems and utilities.
  • Understand the safe operating limits of these systems and parameter control.
  • Start / stop and operate water cooling, coarse / fine filtration, deaeration and seawater injection systems. Understand the safe operating limits of these systems.
  • Philosophy of isolations, Permit to Work, Operational, Fire and Gas, and COSHH Task Evaluation. Basic knowledge of cause and effect.
  • Knowledge of the actions and duties of emergency event response as required in abnormal / emergency situations.
  • Knowledge and understanding of actions required to minimize commercial loss while maintaining safe operation. Prepare / isolate equipment or systems for intrusive maintenance.
  • Responsible for conservation and preservation as well as first line maintenance on production system (valves and equipment).
  • Assist and stand-by when Electrical / Instrumentation and mechanical technicians are working on process systems in order to keep the system safe to perform work.
  • Perform oil and gas pipeline cleaning activities using pigging technology.
  • Communicate effectively with co-workers and communicate any deficiencies to the Control Room Operator and Production Supervisor. Control, operate and optimize daily chemical dosing rates associated with the process system.
  • General organization and maintenance duties in work area.
  • Perform dew point analysis, TOG analysis, BSW analysis, pH analysis
  • Perform external readings according to the frequency defined by the PSUPT, verify the values with the Control Room Operator and report any deviations found to the supervisor, defining corrective measures.
  • To generate clear and simple reports aligned with the task.
  • Other duties that are related to the function, as instructed, and requested by the Production Supervisor Maintain up-to-date certification applied to his/her function and medical certificates Participate in company training, as defined.
  • Ensure compliance with BW procedures as applied to your position, including the work permit system. Comply with all emergency tasks assigned to your role in the emergency response plan, when applicable.
  • Required to be fully familiar with and comply with the Company, Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental Policies and Procedures assigned to your title / position.
  • Anticipate and realize any unsafe condition and ensure that the correct actions are taken as per procedure. Responsible for your own safety and for the safety of your co-workers.
Requirements

Education

  • Technical or equivalent qualification from the country of origin.

Experience

  • Experience in offshore production operations or similar environments.

Knowledge

  • Knowledge aligned with the company's Competence Assurance Assessment requirements.
  • Familiarity with production systems, utilities, chemical dosing, pigging operations, and laboratory/process analyses (dew point, TOG, BSW, pH).
  • Understanding of isolation philosophy, Permit to Work procedures, Fire & Gas principles, emergency response actions, and operational safety requirements.

title: Consulting Opportunity: Summer Portuguese-Speaking Resident Director
description:
Description

CONSULTANT/CONTRACTOR

Compensation for the duration of the assignment: $8,000.00

ANTICIPATED CONTRACT DATES

May - August 2026 (exact dates will vary by program specifics). Resident Director training dates will be announced separately.

Position SUMMARY

American Councils is currently seeking a qualified consultant to serve as a Portuguese-speaking Resident Director to work on a summer Portuguese language program approximately eight weeks in length. The language program offers intensive Portuguese language instruction and structured cultural enrichment experiences designed to promote rapid language gains in undergraduate and graduate students.

The Resident Director represents American Councils on the program overseas. The Resident Director will work with the host institution, manage communications between American Councils, program participants and local staff, advise participants as required, and resolve medical and other issues as necessary.

The Resident Director must be available to program participants on a daily basis; regularly observe classes at the host institution; meet regularly with teachers, administrators, and participants; and chaperone group travel and cultural programs and other events and activities focused on the immersion experience. The Resident Director must be available to participants during any emergencies that arise and must communicate regularly with American Councils program staff in Washington, DC. The Resident Director is not permitted to leave the program site or group excursions to conduct personal travel. The Resident Director oversees a small program budget and is responsible for proper documentation of program expenditures and timely completion of a budget report at the end of each month and at the end of the program. Other reporting requirements may apply.

Prior to departure, the Resident Director will be required to complete an orientation program. The Resident Director may be asked to travel to the program site in advance of the students' arrival. The Resident Director reports to the DC-based Program Manager and staff. Completion of a successful background check may be required. All offers are contingent upon the candidate's ability to receive and maintain a visa to the host country where applicable.

Position Responsibilities

  • Being responsible for and available to a group of American college and graduate students 24/7 at all times during the program;
  • Responding to participant emergencies, including assisting participants with securing medical care and navigating local clinics and hospitals;
  • Advising program participants as needed on a variety of language-learning, cultural, adjustment and logistical aspects of the program, including group dynamics and interpersonal relationships, among others;
  • Reporting on program activities to program staff in Washington, DC, or staff in the host country;
  • Providing supporting to students from a range of backgrounds, including those who have never traveled abroad before;
  • Working closely with the host institution and local program staff on a daily basis;
  • Observing the academic program;
  • Assisting the host institution in managing group travel and cultural programs;
  • Maintaining adherence to program rules and policies among participants, including a language policy;
  • Managing a small budget of program funds and maintaining detailed financial documentation, including monthly reports; 
  • Collecting and tagging photographs and videos from students and local staff;
  • Completing a Resident Director pre-departure orientation and training session;
  • Working with host families, which may include monitoring of host families, conducting site visits, maintaining weekly communication, and assisting with conflict resolution; 
  • Resolving other program-related issues as necessary; and
  • Performing other program-related tasks as directed.
Qualifications
  • Advanced written and oral language skills (minimum 2/2+ on DLPT scale, Advanced on ACTFL scale) in Portuguese;
  • Study, work, or extensive travel experience in Brazil;
  • Experience working in a position of authority with undergraduate or graduate students;
  • Experience overseeing and guiding groups;
  • Demonstrated skills in academic and personal counseling preferred; and
  • Demonstrated skills in general financial accountability.

Additional Information about the Position

Position contingent upon funding and upon the approval of overseas travel for participants. Program location is subject to change prior to program start.

Applicants should provide a description of previous experience in Brazil in their cover letter.  Resumes will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

BENEFITS

This position is not eligible for healthcare benefits.

American Councils is committed to providing employment opportunities for all individuals, in accordance with current federal regulations. Our focus is on ensuring that all individuals have equal access to employment and advancement opportunities based on merit. American Councils' commitment to employment opportunity is driven by federal requirements, including Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act (supporting individuals with disabilities) and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) (protecting covered veterans). We also ensure our employment practices comply with all applicable regulations, including E-Verify requirements for work eligibility. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where all individuals have the opportunity to succeed and grow, in full compliance with federal law.

PAY TRANSPARENCY NONDISCRIMINATION PROVISION

The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

08. Avaliar e validar métodos microbiológicos, equipamentos e sistemas utilizados no monitoramento ambiental.

09. Participar de qualificações de áreas limpas, incluindo classificação, reclassificação e estudos de recuperação.

10. Suportar auditorias internas, externas e inspeções sanitárias (ANVISA, FDA, EMA, entre outras).

11. Treinar e orientar analistas e técnicos de microbiologia quanto às boas práticas, técnicas de amostragem e comportamento em áreas limpas.

12. Atuar de forma integrada com Produção, Garantia da Qualidade, Engenharia e Validação na manutenção do estado de controle microbiológico.

13. Avaliar impactos microbiológicos em mudanças de processo, layout, equipamentos ou utilidades (controle de mudanças).

title: Técnico(a) de Serviços
description:
Description

Resumo do cargo:
O Técnico de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.
Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);

2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;

3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é: 

Você distingue prontamente entre o que é relevante e o que é irrelevante para compreender situações complexas. Você encontra pontos em comum e conduz as coisas para o consenso, garantindo que todos se sintam ouvidos. Você utiliza insights dos clientes para impulsionar e orientar o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam constantemente.

Objective of the role
The Finance Analyst will play a key role in supporting the analysis and structuring of financing transactions, assessing market rates, debt and equity alternatives, and applying advanced financial models. The position is expected to contribute to the design of financial strategies aligned with corporate goals, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and high-quality decision-making.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain financial models for corporate and project transactions, including the use of financing Model A.
  • Review and validate financial models prepared by external advisors, ensuring consistency with company assumptions and industry best practices.
  • Analyse and validate technical and financial assumptions together with specialised teams, assessing their impact on results.
  • Conduct market rate analysis and evaluate its effect on projects and financing structures.
  • Assess financing options (debt and equity), supporting the structuring and negotiation of alternatives.
  • Support capital raising processes (debt and equity), including the preparation of financial materials, participation in due diligence, and interaction with investors and financial institutions.
  • Prepare and contribute to capital presentations for investors, the board of directors, and other key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with internal departments (technical, legal, commercial) and external advisors to ensure timely and accurate information flow.
  • Conduct market and risk analysis to support investment and financing decisions.
  • Prepare financial reports, presentations, and executive summaries for management, investors, and other relevant audiences.
Requirements
  • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial analysis, ideally in investment banking, M&A, and/or debt financing.
  • Advanced skills in financial modelling and analytical tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portugues (mandatory).
  • Spanish is a plus
  • Proactive, versatile, and curious profile with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Commitment to sustainability and diversity values.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to take on new tasks according to business needs.

  • Entrevistas: Realizar entrevistas individuais e coletivas, utilizando metodologias adequadas ao público jovem (foco em potencial, valores, experiências e soft skills);

  • Análise de Indicadores: Acompanhar métricas de fechamento de vagas, SLA (tempo de vaga aberta), taxa de conversão de alunos em processos e qualidade das contratações.

Requisitos e qualificações

title: tecnico de enfermagem do trabalho
description:
Buscamos profissionais que se envolvam, sejam proativos e se interessem por cada detalhe dos nossos projetos e, acima de tudo, que queiram crescer e dar o seu melhor, todos os dias. Buscamos um profissional responsável por executar e manter a gestão técnico-operacional dos processos de saúde ocupacional, assegurando conformidade normativa, integridade dos registros e suporte contínuo a empresa-cliente no que se refere ao uso e operação do sistema SOC

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Operar e administrar o sistema SOC, por meio do acesso, atualização, parametrização e controle das informações de saúde ocupacional, a fim de garantir a gestão adequada e contínua dos processos de SST do cliente.
  • Validar e estruturar documentos de saúde ocupacional, por meio da análise técnica dos materiais recebidos e da correta inclusão dos exames previstos no PCMSO, a fim de assegurar conformidade legal, completude das informações e aderência às exigências normativas.
  • Cadastrar e parametrizar exames ocupacionais no sistema, por meio da configuração conforme o PCMSO vigente, a fim de garantir que todos os exames obrigatórios estejam corretamente vinculados aos colaboradores e aos programas de saúde.
  • Analisar relatórios e elaborar conclusões técnicas, por meio da avaliação dos dados de exames realizados, a fim de atender à NR-07, apoiar a gestão de saúde ocupacional e registrar considerações técnicas pertinentes.
  • Gerenciar prazos, vencimentos e periódicos de saúde ocupacional, por meio do controle sistemático e comunicação preventiva ao cliente, a fim de evitar não conformidades legais, atrasos e exposição a sanções.
  • Capacitar e orientar usuários do cliente quanto ao uso do sistema SOC, por meio de treinamentos presenciais, online e atendimentos recorrentes, a fim de garantir o correto manuseio da ferramenta, a autonomia operacional e a redução de erros.
  • Atender e acompanhar demandas operacionais da empresa cliente e do núcleo interno, por meio de contato telefônico, e-mail e registros em sistema, a fim de assegurar fluidez no atendimento, clareza nas devolutivas e eficiência na resolução de solicitações.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento e feedback com o cliente, por meio de encontros presenciais ou online, a fim de apresentar resultados, indicadores operacionais e fortalecer o relacionamento e a transparência da gestão.
    Realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo exercido, conforme necessidade e/ou e demanda da área, sempre que necessário, por meio de treinamento, qualificação profissional e orientações do líder imediato, a fim de garantir o desenvolvimento profissional contínuo.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Técnico de Enfermagem com registro ativo;
  • Ter domínio em Pacote Office.
  • Experiência anterior na área de Enfermagem do Trabalho e Saúde Ocupacional e com normas regulamentadoras (NRs);
  • Experiência em sistema SOC (cadastro, parametrização, controle de exames, vencimentos e relatórios);
  • Experiência com documentação de saúde ocupacional, prontuários, laudos, relatórios técnicos e registros exigidos por lei;
  • Foco no cliente colaboração, criatividade e profissionalismo.

title: Electrical Supervisor
description:

Req Id: 21542

Job Family: Electrical Offshore

Description:

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To

  • Maintenance Superintendent

Background

  • The Electrical Supervisor will exhibit exemplary safety and supervisory skills in all matters pertaining to electrical maintenance works on and pertinent to the vessel. They are responsible for ensuring its subordinates are competent to carry out their allotted tasks and confirming and clarifying the status of electrical personnel, (whether CEP or LAEP or LEP)

Authority

  • Safety, competence, and maintenance related to electrical systems and equipment, subordinate personnel, subcontractors, inspectors, and external and ad hoc services. They liaise effectively with other key management personnel.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Electrical technicians, Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives.

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies

Offshore - Isolation and Switching Procedures on HV/LV Distribution Boards

Offshore - AC and DC UPS Systems

Offshore - Electrical Test Equipment

Offshore - Black Start and Power Outage Reinstatement

Offshore - Hazardous Area Classification

Offshore - Safety Management

Offshore - Earthing and Bonding

Offshore - HV/LV Transformers

Offshore - Synchronising Generators

Offshore - HV/LV Generation

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience

  • After recruitment the Electrical Supervisor will be authorized to the appropriate level by the O &M Contractor Electrical Assessor or Senior Asset Electrical Engineer.
  • Qualified to at least HNC / HND, or NVQ Level 3 or recognized equivalent in Electrical Maintenance Engineering.
  • A minimum of 5 years' experience preferred including 3 years offshore petrochemical experience desired.
  • 3 years' experience as Supervisor with prior Senior Authorized position.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of PTW, Electrical Isolation Standards, Risk Assessment, Power Management System, Generation on LV.
  • COMP-EX Certified.
  • Preferred courses achieved: HV Protection Relays and HVLV Switching.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of B2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.
